Rail — Rimless Cycling Sunglasses Built for the Bike and the Diamond

Rail is Tifosi's innovative rimless cycling sunglasses, purpose-built for cyclists and baseball players who demand maximum coverage, superior airflow, and a lightweight fit that never gets in the way. The oversized rimless shield frame delivers increased eye protection and unobstructed vision, while the shatterproof lenses ensure long-term durability through the most demanding rides and games. With a patented design that sets Rail apart from every other option in the lineup, this is rimless sport eyewear engineered to perform.

Rimless Cycling Sunglasses Built for Maximum Coverage

Rail's innovative oversized rimless frame provides increased coverage and protection, shielding your eyes from debris, wind, and harmful UV rays across every mile and every inning. The shatterproof lenses are built to withstand the demands of cycling and baseball alike, delivering long-term protection and optical clarity through season after season of hard use. Rail's patented rimless shield design ensures you get the coverage you need without the bulk you don't.

Lightweight Comfort for Uninterrupted Performance

Weighing just 32 grams, Rail is designed to disappear during your most intense rides and games, letting you focus entirely on performance without distraction. The rimless shield frame maximizes airflow, keeping you cool and comfortable whether you're pushing through a long bike leg or tracking a fly ball under the afternoon sun. Lightweight, durable, and built for all-day wear, Rail is the rimless cycling sunglasses that serious athletes keep reaching for.

A Secure Fit for Cyclists and Baseball Players

Rail is crafted with the latest materials and technology to meet the unique demands of cyclists and baseball players at every level of competition. Whether you're a professional athlete pushing your limits or a weekend rider enjoying the open road, Rail delivers the ultimate combination of comfort, style, and functionality. Trust in the quality and performance that Rail brings to every stride on the cycling path and every swing on the baseball field.

Rimless Sport Sunglasses That Go the Distance

Rail is more than eyewear — it's a partner in your cycling and baseball journey, delivering confidence and clarity from the first pedal stroke to the final out. The rimless shield design provides superior protection from debris while ensuring maximum airflow, making Rail the ideal choice for athletes who refuse to compromise on performance or comfort. Invest in Rail today and experience the transformative difference that purpose-built rimless cycling sunglasses bring to every ride and every game.

SHIPPING

Orders placed by 2pm EST on business days will ship that day. Orders placed after cut-off will ship the next business day. Tifosi offers free shipping on orders $49.95 and up.

FREE RETURNS

If you’re looking to return your order for whatever reason, we’re here to help! We offer free returns within 30 days of receiving your order. Return Center

LIFETIME WARRANTY

At Tifosi Optics™ we have built our name through our customer service and standing behind our product 100%. Therefore, we will warranty any sunglass against manufacturer’s defects to the original owner for the life of the product. Tifosi Optics will either replace or repair your glasses at our discretion. Learn more about warranty claims.

Great Biking Glasses

I can't say enough about the Rail glasses. They're great - comfortable and very functional. I love the way that they get darker or clearer depending on the amount of sunlight. They're very customizable, with the earpieces. They're a single piece of polycarbonate rather than two lenses give me greater vision.
But all that is well and good - I had a bad biking accident and hit the ground headfirst (wearing a helmet and the Tifosi glasses). After the fall, I took a look at my glasses. The earpieces and nose pieces had become detached but the lens was intact with a huge scrape on the lens. Without the glasses, that would have been my eye. And they didn't chip or shatter - they saved my eyesight.
Customer for life.
